verdict.rationale: Sill is documented as a tool for interactive control, not passive viewing: touch, keyboard, trackpad gestures and Apple Pencil input all reach the Mac. It also manages stream responsiveness, detecting when it is holding frames back and offering a quality the link can carry, plus manual and adaptive quality settings. However, nothing states that encoding is hardware-accelerated or quantifies latency. Missing for 10: any evidence of hardware (e.g. VideoToolbox) encoding, documented latency figures or low-latency claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration of responsiveness.
